reference_title: Eurocode 7: Geotechnical Design - Part 1: General Rules
chapter_title: Annex E (informative): A sample semi-empirical method for bearing resistance estimation

sections.title: Annex E: Pressuremeter-based bearing resistance
sections.summary: Design bearing resistance from pressuremeter test results: Rd/A' = sigma_v0 + k*p*le, where sigma_v0 is the initial total vertical stress, k is a bearing-resistance factor in the range 0.8 to 3.0 (by soil type, embedment depth, foundation shape), and p*le is the design net equivalent limit pressure, itself derived from the pressuremeter's net limit pressure p*l = pl - p0, with p0 = Ko*sigma'v + u. Fully implemented as pressuremeter_bearing_resistance.
sections.body: To estimate the design bearing resistance of a foundation on soil, field tests such as the pressuremeter test may be used. When using the pressuremeter, the design bearing resistance Rd of a foundation subjected to a vertical load is related to the limit pressure of the soil by the linear function Rd/A' = sigma_v0 + k*p*le, where k is the bearing resistance factor, sigma_v0 is the initial total vertical stress, and p*le is the design net equivalent limit pressure from the pressuremeter test. Numerical values of the bearing resistance factor k are in the range 0.8 to 3.0, depending on the type of soil, the embedment depth, and the shape of the foundation. The design net equivalent limit pressure p*le is derived from the net limit pressure p*l, defined for a pressuremeter test as the difference (pl - p0) between the limit pressure pl and the at-rest horizontal earth pressure p0 at the level of the test; p0 may be determined from an estimate of the at-rest earth pressure coefficient Ko and the values of the effective overburden pressure sigma'v and the pore-water pressure u, as p0 = Ko*sigma'v + u.
key_points: Rd/A' = sigma_v0 + k*p*le -- linear relation between bearing resistance and pressuremeter limit pressure
k (bearing resistance factor) ranges 0.8 to 3.0 depending on soil type, embedment depth, and foundation shape
p*le = design net equivalent limit pressure, derived from the pressuremeter net limit pressure p*l = pl - p0
p0 (at-rest horizontal earth pressure at test level) = Ko*sigma'v + u

equations.description: Design bearing resistance from pressuremeter results: Rd/A' = sigma_v0 + k*p*le.

sections.applicability: Estimating shallow-foundation bearing resistance directly from pressuremeter (PMT) field test results, as an alternative to the analytical Annex D method when phi'/c'/cu are not well characterised but PMT data are available.
